title: XTP provisioning protected MI admission and bounded ingress
summary: XTP dev34 now carries per-service session protection and persistent FIRST->KEY, but service key alone does not identify a unique MI. New dev2 native ooRexx XtpProvisionIngress enforces encrypted xtp.provision session metadata, an independent exclusive MI identity/fence decision, and bounded EOM framing before handing out opaque bytes. No route mutation, LDAP resolver, quorum commit or ED209 deployment claimed.
invariants: Use existing dev34 protected XtpSession and sticky encrypt profile; never silently downgrade to clear or authenticate-only
A service-owned shared key authenticates a service key holder, NOT the MI: the privileged Identity Directory resolver must prove exclusive key-to-MI binding, epoch fence and current ACL
Reject if KEYID, service, protection, OPEN state, authority, principal or identity scope is missing or mismatched
Max request bytes, frame count and per-read timeout are enforced with an abort on malformed/incomplete requests
No serialized body becomes authority merely because it arrived on protected XTP; independently verify Ed25519/quorum/target/policy and durable commit before route activation
No IP under named-service descriptors; only XTP route engine may mutate route/carrier state; preserve seed and emergency access
No field readiness claims from injected-stub ooRexx tests
procedure: Use packages/oorexx_xtp_v0.1-dev34/docs/SECURITY.md and rexx/XtpSession.cls to locate exact session info fields; v34 is per-service protection and persistent sessions, not a provisioning authorization layer
Run REXX_BIN=/path/to/rexx tests/run.sh on provision dev2; 20 native deterministic admission/framing checks PASS locally on r13196
Read xtp_route_publication_v0.1-dev2/docs/DEV2_INTEGRATION.md for privileged LDAP resolver and frame handling gates
Consume new principal/session-binding interface only after the XTP owner specifies its exact authority; project coordination REQ-00001829
Continue controller-signed allocations and atomic gateway CONFIG_PREPARE/ACTIVATE/REVERT in a separate increment; ED209 raw36/L2 later
